blocks.text: “Balota” director Kip Oebanda revealed that lead star Marian Rivera only took just a day’s worth of her talent fee from the movie and gave the rest to her crew and to an educational charity. The film director disclosed this as he attested to the actress’ generosity through his X page on Monday, Nov. 9. Oebanda’s revelation came after veteran actress Odette Khan recently recalled the financial help Rivera extended her. “Secret’s out I guess. Marian donated to Mommy Odette for her treatment despite their complicated history. Marami pang ginagawang ganyan si Marian, hindi lang public,” Oebanda said. Secret’s out I […]...
